values.task_boundary: Deliver v0.93 handoff and downstream planning update.
deliverables: v0.93 handoff and downstream planning update
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: WP-27 is merged, terminal, claim-free, ancestral, and the handoff consumes the final quality/review/remediation disposition universe.
AC-2: Every v0.93 prerequisite/work area has exact v0.92 evidence, an evidence-backed blocker, an accountable follow-on, or explicit non-claim plus owner and acceptance hook.
AC-3: The v0.93 README, WBS, feature set, candidate wave, checklist, demo matrix, release plan, and security/governance boundaries are mutually consistent and decision-ready.
AC-4: Candidate/forward-planning status remains explicit; no issue creation, activation, implementation, schedule, legal-personhood, production-authority, or certification claim is introduced.
AC-5: YAML/Markdown/links, dependency coverage, owners, acceptance hooks, evidence identities, redaction, and negative claim-boundary scans pass.
AC-6: Exact-head docs review has no actionable finding and hands a self-contained packet to WP-28A without downstream completion claims.
repo_inputs: Terminal WP-27 quality, internal/external review, and remediation evidence
Current docs/milestones/v0.93 candidate package, whose status remains forward_planning_candidate/candidate_issue_wave
non_goals: Creating v0.93 issues, activating the milestone, implementing features, or setting release dates
Interpreting missing v0.92 evidence as governance, security, rights, duties, standing, or citizenship approval
Legal personhood, production constitutional authority, or external certification claims
